label: Keller Williams Scraper
title: Keller Williams Scraper: kw.com Sale, Rent & Sold Listings
metaDescription: Scrape kw.com listings for sale, for rent and sold: prices, photos, features, HOA, schools, agent contacts and price history. Paste a search link or a place.
intro: Paste a kw.com search or property link, or type a place, and get Keller Williams listings for sale, for rent and sold: price, address, beds, baths, size, photos, features, HOA, nearby schools, price and tax history, open houses and the listing agent. Search links keep every filter you set on kw.com.
useCases: Build lead lists of listing agents in a city
Track prices, price cuts and sold prices in a neighborhood
Feed a property database or valuation model with fresh listings

faq.q: Is there an official Keller Williams listings API?
faq.a: No public one. Listing data normally comes through MLS feeds, which need a broker or MLS membership. This actor reads the listings any visitor can see on kw.com.

faq.q: Can I use my own kw.com search?
faq.a: Yes. Set your filters on kw.com (price, beds, property type, keywords, open houses, price reduced…), copy the link and paste it; the actor applies the same filters.
